coordinates.locator: centroid of OpenStreetMap building 1010 (RHIC interaction point 10, the 10 o'clock position); clock position from arXiv:nucl-ex/0503018 Section 2.1
coordinates.note: Campus-grade point, shown as approximate. PHOBOS's interaction region is the 10 o'clock position of the RHIC ring (thesis quote). The building is identified as 1010 by the RHIC numbering pattern (BNL's central campus map labels IP6 and IP8 as buildings 1006 and 1008) and by its position: the clock position derived from the OSM RHIC-ring geometry and the STAR/PHENIX halls falls within about 30 m of this building. No fetched source names the building that housed PHOBOS, hence confidence uncertain.
coordinates.quote: the four current experiments are at 6 o’clock (STAR), 8 o’clock (PHENIX), 10 o’clock (PHOBOS) and 2 o’clock (BRAHMS)

name: RHIC Interaction Point 10 (PHOBOS experimental hall)
notes: Interaction-point assignment from arXiv:nucl-ex/0503018; building identity inferred (see coordinate note).

summary.plain: The experimental hall at RHIC interaction point 10, at the 10 o'clock position of the collider ring at Brookhaven National Laboratory, where PHOBOS recorded heavy-ion collisions.
summary.technical: RHIC interaction region 10 (10 o'clock) experimental area, Brookhaven National Laboratory; the point is the centroid of the OpenStreetMap building 1010 (about 100 m precision), identified by the RHIC building-numbering pattern, not a surveyed detector position.
